title: Model-facing quant defaults: staged onramp, calibration harness, and rollback criteria
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Define per-model default quantization prescriptions (FP8 / INT8) surfaced in the model catalog and implement a staged onramp workflow that ensures accuracy guardrails. This ticket covers the guidance text, the calibration harness that produces candidate profiles, the shadow/validation pass criteria, and the production gating (canary + safemode fallback). The goal is to provide an opinionated default per model that balances cost reduction and accuracy preservation while making it straightforward for engineers to opt in, audit, and roll back. This work must integrate with the catalog provenance, runtime profile selection, and rollout/rollback automation in the console.
acceptance_criteria: Per-model default record in model catalog with fields: recommended_profiles (list), recommended_calibration_dataset, expected_accuracy_delta_thresholds
Calibration harness can produce FP8 and INT8 candidate profiles and a human-readable calibration report for a given model and dataset
Shadow validation pipeline runs end-to-end on representative eval sets and emits pass/fail with metrics and confidence bands
Console exposes a one-click rollout that performs: canary (1% traffic), monitor, 10% ramp, 100% or rollback to FP16/FP32 fallback if thresholds violated
Profile artifacts include unique profile checksum and provenance links (commit, PR, calibration dataset snapshot)
Automated regression detection: any model-profile pair that exceeds configured accuracy regression bands generates an alert and blocks auto-promotion
implementation_notes: Calibration harness: Dockerizable job that runs representative micro-batches, collects activation distribution histograms, and outputs scale/zero params for INT8 and exponent calibration for FP8
Sampling strategy: stratified by token length and by prompt-type; include adversarial prompts from recent production traces (scrubbed)
Store candidate profiles as artifacts in model-catalog storage with immutable keys and include a human-readable summary JSON
Runtime integration: profiles attach to model descriptor; runtime should accept 'profile' override and fall back to 'default_profile' when routing policies choose cheaper variants

For speed, consider using per-layer symmetric quant for INT8 and dynamic exponent allocation for FP8 as the default path, with notes about known model architectures that should avoid FP8 (e.g., fragile layernorm variants)
test_plan: Unit tests for calibration job input validation and profile serialization
Integration tests: run calibration harness on small-model smoke fixture and validate profile artifact is consumable by serving runtime
Shadow validation: run both FP8 and INT8 candidate profiles on existing eval suites (LM perplexity, instruction-following accuracy, NLU tasks where applicable) and compare to FP16 baseline
A/B test plan to measure user-visible regressions on real-world prompts for customers with opt-in flag (metric buckets and alert thresholds defined)
Fail-open tests: force profile artifact corruption and ensure runtime falls back to default non-quantized model without request loss
rollout_plan: Stage 0: dry-run in CI producing calibration reports for every new candidate profile
Stage 1: shadow validation for N model seeds for 72 hours, collect delta distributions and confidence intervals
Stage 2: internal canary (internal traffic only, 1%) for 24h with automatic rollback if regressions cross thresholds
Stage 3: progressive ramp (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) with guard rails and automated rollback if monitored signals degrade
Stage 4: promote profile to 'recommended' in catalog with explicit release notes and a 7-day review window before auto-enforcement
rollback_criteria: Absolute metric regression: any core metric (perplexity/accuracy/F1/EM) worse than baseline by configured absolute delta (e.g., >0.5% absolute accuracy drop or >2% relative perplexity increase)
User-facing error rate increase (5xxs or timeouts) above baseline + 3 sigma
Latent drift in distribution of outputs detected (semantic similarity drop below 0.97 on pairwise baseline comparisons)
Manual override by on-call or product owner via console with immediate fallback to FP16/FP32 view
analytics_signals: Per-token latency and P99/P95 breakdown by profile
Token generation cost delta (est. GPU cycles) vs FP16 baseline
Eval suite pass-rate and confidence band time-series
Shadow-score distributions (paired comparison between baseline and quantized output using chosen evaluation metrics)
Customer opt-in ratio and rollback incidence per model
